plan.name: ReplyIQ Serious Testing Suite
plan.objective: Build an automated test harness that traps silent failures in three critical pipelines: (1) the signup RLS bypass, (2) the frontend verification redirect, and (3) the distributed poller mutex. These tests must be runnable in CI with zero manual steps and must fail loudly if any regression is introduced.

file.description:
Add 4 critical tests that the existing suite is missing:
TEST A — Orphan Auth Cleanup on Profile Failure When create_user_profile RPC raises an exception, the signup route MUST call supabase.auth.admin.delete_user() with the new user_id before returning 500. If this call is missing, you get an orphaned auth.users row that blocks future signups with the same email AND wastes quota.
TEST B — Fake-User / Duplicate Email Detection When Supabase returns a user object with an EMPTY identities list, the route must return 409 EMAIL_EXISTS — NOT attempt an RPC insert. This catches the silent duplicate scenario where Supabase does not raise an exception but instead returns a fake user object.
TEST C — Profile-Exists But No Session (202 with email in response) Confirm that the 202 response body only contains {status, message} and DOES NOT leak the user's internal ID or profile data. The frontend uses the URL param, not any response body field, to set the verify-email page.
TEST D — Login Blocked When Profile Row is Missing Simulate: Supabase auth succeeds (returns session) but get_user_by_id returns None (profile never created — the exact orphan scenario). Must return 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, not 200.

test.name: test_signup_orphan_cleanup_on_profile_error
test.assert: supabase.auth.admin.delete_user called with correct user_id when RPC raises

test.name: test_login_blocked_when_profile_missing
test.setup: mock Supabase auth.sign_in returns valid session, get_user_by_id returns None

file.description: Tests that verify the CONTRACT expected from the create_user_profile RPC. These are unit tests with mocked Supabase, but they verify that: 1. The correct parameter names (p_id, p_email, p_business_name, etc.) are passed to supabase.rpc() — if someone renames an arg, this breaks. 2. A RuntimeError is raised when the RPC returns empty data (result.data is falsy). 3. The returned object is passed directly to the caller (dict passthrough).

test.name: test_create_user_rpc_called_with_correct_params
test.assert: params dict has keys: p_id, p_email, p_business_name, p_business_type, p_tone_preference

test.name: test_create_user_rpc_raises_on_empty_data
test.assert: RuntimeError raised with message containing "no data"

file.description:
Unit tests for the _try_acquire_lock() and _release_lock() functions in run_poller.py. These tests fully mock the Supabase RPC layer.
TEST H — Lock Acquired When RPC Returns True When acquire_poller_lock RPC returns truthy data, _try_acquire_lock() must return True and the poller proceeds.
TEST I — Lock Skipped When RPC Returns Falsy When acquire_poller_lock RPC returns falsy data (another instance holds the lock), _try_acquire_lock() returns False.
TEST J — Fail-Closed on Network Error When the RPC call itself raises an Exception (network timeout, etc.), _try_acquire_lock() must return False (NOT raise). This is the "fail closed" safety guarantee.
TEST K — run_google_poller Skips Body When Lock Not Acquired Patch _try_acquire_lock to return False. Verify that _run_poller_body is NEVER called and that a "poller_skipped" event is logged.
TEST L — run_google_poller Always Releases Lock (Even on Exception) Patch _try_acquire_lock to return True, _run_poller_body to raise. Verify _release_lock() is still called (finally block guard).

wave.name: Frontend E2E (TestSprite)
wave.setup: Bootstrap TestSprite for frontend at port 5173. Generate a focused test plan covering the signup onboarding flow.

scenarios.scenario: Fill signup form with valid data. Submit form. ASSERT: URL changes to /verify-email. ASSERT: ?email= query param is present and matches the entered email. ASSERT: The verify-email page renders (not a blank screen or error).
Fill and submit the signup form. ASSERT: Submit button shows spinner / "Creating account…" text while loading. ASSERT: Button is disabled during loading (prevents double-submit).
Mock the API to return 409. ASSERT: Error alert is visible. ASSERT: Form is not cleared (user can correct email).
Enter a password with fewer than 8 characters. Submit form. ASSERT: Error message visible without any network call being made.

file.description: Add test markers: unit, integration, e2e. Configure testpaths to include tests/routes, tests/services. Set addopts = --tb=short -q so failures are immediately visible.

A single shell script that runs ALL waves in sequence: 1. pytest tests/routes/test_auth.py -m unit 2. pytest tests/routes/test_auth_rpc_contract.py -m unit 3. pytest tests/services/test_poller_mutex.py -m unit Exit non-zero if any suite fails. Human-readable summary at the end.
